description: Wait until a console line matching a regex appears in the active capture (see roku_console_capture_start). Returns line number, timestamp and a short redacted preview; the full line is in the capture file. Resolves early with reason "waiting_for_debugger" if the channel is blocked waiting for the VS Code debugger (redeploy it with roku_deploy).

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression tested against each console line

predicate.description: jwtValid: only accept lines whose "Authorization: Bearer <jwt>" has a future exp

sinceCaptureStart.description: Also match lines already captured; false = only lines arriving after this call

name: roku_console_wait
